name: 2-methyl-1-butanol
description: 2-Methyl-1-butanol (CAS 137-32-6 ), also known as primary active amyl alcohol, is a chiral aliphatic alcohol used across food, cosmetic, and polymer manufacturing. It functions primarily as a flavoring agent and solvent. This chemical serves as a vital intermediate in the synthesis of esters and other derivatives. In food and beverage production, it is approved under FEMA 3998 as a flavoring ingredient for various applications. It contributes significantly to fruit and fermented flavor profiles in finished products. Cosmetic formulators use it as a solvent and co-solvent in fragrance compounds and hair care formulations where performance is required. The product is also utilized in topical preparations where controlled evaporation and carrier performance are essential. In polymer and plastics processing, it serves as a reactive intermediate for manufacturing. It is used in the production of plasticizers, resins, and cross-linking agents. It also functions as a precursor to amyl esters, such as amyl acetate, used in both flavor and industrial coating applications. The material is supplied as a clear liquid in drums and IBC containers. Food-grade material meeting FCC specifications is available for flavor industry applications to ensure high quality and safety. Technical-grade is supplied for industrial and polymer end uses where specific regulatory standards are not required. Purity levels typically range from 98% upward depending on the intended application. Our supply chain ensures consistent availability for global manufacturers.
